train on customers&#x27; API requests?</a></h2></span><span class="not-prose"><div class="[&amp;_a]:decoration-current/50 bg-card my-5 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 font-sans text-xs leading-5 [&amp;_a]:text-inherit [&amp;_a]:underline text-primary/80 flex flex-row items-start gap-2"><div class="flex items-center gap-2 ml-0 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0 self-start"><div class="flex-shrink-0"><svg [&amp;_code]:font-mono [&amp;_strong]:rounded [&amp;_strong]:font-semibold"><p>xAI never trains on your API inputs or outputs without your explicit permission.</p></div></div></span><p>By default, all API requests and responses are stored on our servers (encrypted at rest) for 30 days for auditing purposes in the event of suspected abuse or misuse. xAI does not train on this data, and it is automatically deleted after 30 days.</p><p>For teams that require stricter data handling, see <a href="#what-is-zero-data-retention-zdr" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Zero Data Retention (ZDR)</a> below.</p><hr/><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="what-is-zero-data-retention-zdr" class="scroll-mt-28 font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary mb-4 mt-12 text-xl leading-snug"><a class="not-prose" href="#what-is-zero-data-retention-zdr">What is Zero Data Retention (ZDR)?</a></h2></span><span class="not-prose"><div class="bg-card my-5 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 font-sans text-xs leading-5 [&amp;_a]:text-inherit [&amp;_a]:underline text-[hsl(44,20%,30%)] dark:text-[hsl(44,20%,65%)] [&amp;_a]:decoration-[hsl(44,25%,55%)] dark:[&amp;_a]:decoration-[hsl(44,20%,38%)] flex flex-row items-start gap-2"><div class="flex items-center gap-2 ml-0 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0 self-start"><div class="flex-shrink-0"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" data-slot="icon" class="stroke-[2] size-3.5 dark:text-[#555] text-fg-warning"><path d="M2.7261 15.4565L9.42753 4.28744C10.5927 2.34543 13.4073 2.34543 14.5725 4.28745L21.2739 15.4565C22.4737 17.4561 21.0333 20 18.7014 20H5.29858C2.96669 20 1.52636 17.4561 2.7261 15.4565Z" stroke="currentColor"></path><circle cx="11.9998" cy="15.4" r="1.2" fill="currentColor"></circle><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M12.395 7.5C12.9866 7.5 13.4489 8.01082 13.39 8.5995L13 12.5H11L10.61 8.5995C10.5511 8.01082 11.0134 7.5 11.605 7.5H12.395Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div></div><div class="min-w-0 flex-1 [&amp;&gt;p:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;&gt;p:last-child]:mb-0 [&amp;_code]:font-mono [&amp;_strong]:rounded [&amp;_strong]:font-semibold"><p><strong>For most customers, we do not recommend enabling ZDR</strong>. ZDR disables important API features that depend on stored data, including the stateful Responses API, Files and Collections, and the Batch API (see the full list below). Because content deleted under ZDR can never be recovered or produced by xAI, only enable it when your compliance requirements truly demand it. For most teams, the default 30-day retention is the better choice.</p></div></div></span><ul>
<li><strong>No storage of prompts:</strong> ZDR ensures that API request inputs (i.e., your prompt) and outputs (i.e., the tokens generated by the LLM) are never persisted to disk. The 30-day audit retention described above does not apply to ZDR-enabled teams.</li>
<li><strong>Applied at a team level:</strong> If enabled, ZDR is team-wide. There is no ability to enable ZDR for specific API keys.</li>
<li><strong>Self-serve:</strong> Where available, a team admin can turn it on or off directly from the <a href="https://console.x.ai/team/default/settings/team?utm_source=docs&amp;utm_medium=referral&amp;utm_campaign=developers-faq-security&amp;utm_content=team-settings" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">xAI Console</a>. When enabled, it applies to every API key on the team.</li>
</ul><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="features-not-supported-with-zdr" class="scroll-mt-28 font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary mb-3 mt-10 text-lg leading-normal"><a class="not-prose" href="#features-not-supported-with-zdr">Features not supported with ZDR</a></h3></span><p>Any capability that relies on xAI storing data is unavailable while ZDR is enabled:</p><div class="not-prose my-6 w-full overflow-x-auto"><table class="w-full border-collapse text-left text-sm [&amp;_thead_tr]:border-border [&amp;_thead_tr]:border-b [&amp;_th]:text-secondary [&amp;_th]:px-3 [&amp;_th]:py-2.5 [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_th]:align-bottom [&amp;_th]:text-sm [&amp;_th]:font-light [&amp;_tbody]:divide-border [&amp;_tbody]:divide-y [&amp;_td]:px-3 [&amp;_td]:py-4 [&amp;_td]:align-top [&amp;_td:first-child]:text-primary [&amp;_td:first-child]:font-medium [&amp;_td:first-child]:!pl-0 [&amp;_th:first-child]:!pl-0 [&amp;_td_li]:before:text-subtle [&amp;_td_li]:before:mr-1.5 [&amp;_td_li]:before:content-[&quot;•&quot;] [&amp;_td_ul]:m-0 [&amp;_td_ul]:list-none [&amp;_td_ul]:space-y-1.5 [&amp;_td_ul]:p-0 [&amp;_tbody_tr:last-child_td]:border-b-0"><thead><tr><th>Feature</th><th>Why it is unavailable under ZDR</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>Per-API-key request logging</strong></td><td>Recording the full request and response for each API key so you can review them in the Console. Under ZDR, request and response logs are not retained, and any existing per-key request-logging flags are cleared when ZDR is enabled.</td></tr><tr><td><strong><a href="/developers/model-capabilities/text/generate-text#chaining-the-conversation" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Stateful Responses API</a></strong></td><td>A mode where xAI stores your conversation server-side so you can continue it later by referencing a previous response. That history cannot be stored under ZDR (<span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">store_messages</code></span>, <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">previous_response_id</code></span>), so the client must store conversation history on the client side instead. Please remember to enable <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">use_encrypted_content</code></span> for <a href="/developers/tools/advanced-usage#append-the-encrypted-agentic-tool-calling-states" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">agentic tool-calling state</a>.</td></tr><tr><td><strong><a href="/developers/files" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Files API</a></strong></td><td>Lets you upload a file to xAI once and reference it by <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">file_id</code></span> across later requests. Uploaded files are stored server-side, so under ZDR new uploads and <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">file_id</code></span> attachments are blocked. Existing files can still be viewed and deleted.</td></tr><tr><td><strong><a href="/developers/files/collections" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Collections API</a></strong></td><td>Stores your documents on xAI so Grok can search and retrieve from them (RAG). Those documents must be stored to be retrieved, which ZDR does not allow. Existing collections can still be viewed and deleted.</td></tr><tr><td><strong><a href="/developers/advanced-api-usage/batch-api" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Batch API</a></strong></td><td>Processes large sets of requests asynchronously at a discounted price. Batched requests are stored until they are processed, so the Batch API is unavailable under ZDR.</td></tr><tr><td><strong><a href="/developers/advanced-api-usage/deferred-chat-completions" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Deferred completions</a></strong></td><td>Return a request ID right away and let you fetch the result later instead of holding the connection open. That result is stored until you retrieve it, which ZDR does not permit. Concurrent client-side requests (for example via <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">AsyncClient</code></span>) are unaffected.</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Stored <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/images/generation" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">image</a> and <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/video/generation" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">video</a> outputs</strong></td><td>Image and video generation can have xAI host the generated media and return it as a <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">file_id</code></span> or URL. Under ZDR there is no xAI-side output storage: no <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">file_id</code></span> inputs, no stored outputs, and no URL-format image results. For images, return base64 only. For video, you must supply your own <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">output.upload_url</code></span> (xAI uploads the result to your URL). Image generation is also limited to <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">grok-imagine</code></span> models and excludes agentic image generation. Video generation in the Console playground is unavailable for the same reason.</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Voice agent conversation history</strong></td><td>Voice agent conversations are not persisted when ZDR is enabled.</td></tr></tbody></table></div><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="how-to-enable-zdr" class="scroll-mt-28 font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary mb-3 mt-10 text-lg leading-normal"><a class="not-prose" href="#how-to-enable-zdr">How to enable ZDR</a></h3></span><p>Team admins can enable or disable ZDR from the Console:</p><ol>
<li>Sign in to the <a href="https://console.x.ai/?utm_source=docs&amp;utm_medium=referral&amp;utm_campaign=developers-faq-security&amp;utm_content=console-home" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">xAI Console</a> as a team admin and select the team you want to change in the team picker.</li>
<li>Delete any existing <a href="/developers/files" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Files</a> and <a href="/developers/files/collections" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Collections</a> for that team. The Console blocks Enable while stored files or collections remain.</li>
<li>Open <strong>Team Settings</strong> and find the <strong>Zero Data Retention (ZDR)</strong> row, then click <strong>Enable</strong>.</li>
<li>Review the acknowledgments in the confirmation dialog, including that deleted User Content cannot be recovered, and accept the Enterprise Terms and Privacy Policy. Click <strong>Enable</strong> to confirm.</li>
</ol><p>Once enabled, ZDR applies automatically to all API requests made with that team&#x27;s API keys—no code changes are required. To turn it off later, use the same <strong>Zero Data Retention (ZDR)</strong> row and choose <strong>Disable</strong>.</p><p>If you do not see the ZDR option, you may not be a team admin, self-serve ZDR may not be enabled for your environment yet, or your team may be on a negotiated Enterprise Customer Agreement that governs retention separately—contact <a href="mailto:sales@x.ai" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">sales@x.ai</a> in that case.</p><span class="not-prose"><h3 id="how-to-check-that-zdr-is-enabled" class="scroll-mt-28 font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary mb-3 mt-10 text-lg leading-normal"><a class="not-prose" href="#how-to-check-that-zdr-is-enabled">How to check that ZDR is enabled</a></h3></span><ul>
<li><strong>Team Settings:</strong> the <strong>Zero Data Retention (ZDR)</strong> row shows an <strong>Active</strong> badge.</li>
<li><strong>Team picker:</strong> the <a href="https://console.x.ai/?utm_source=docs&amp;utm_medium=referral&amp;utm_campaign=developers-faq-security&amp;utm_content=console-home" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">xAI Console</a> team picker shows a <strong>ZDR</strong> badge next to your team name (tooltip: Zero Data Retention).</li>
<li><strong>Response header:</strong> every API response includes an <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">x-zero-data-retention</code></span> header set to <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">&quot;true&quot;</code></span> or <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">&quot;false&quot;</code></span>, so your application can programmatically confirm whether ZDR is active.</li>
<li><strong>Audit logs:</strong> administrative events (key creation, team changes, etc.) still appear in the Console audit log, but the content of API requests and responses does not.</li>
</ul><hr/><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="grok-build-cli" class="scroll-mt-28 font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary mb-4 mt-12 text-xl leading-snug"><a class="not-prose" href="#grok-build-cli">Grok Build CLI</a></h2></span><p>If you are using the Grok Build CLI with ZDR enabled, no trace or code data is retained.</p><p>When using the Grok Build CLI without ZDR, privacy settings are available as a slash command (<span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">/privacy</code></span>) and in settings (<span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">/settings</code></span>). You can disable code data retention with these settings, even if ZDR is not enabled.</p><p>On using the Grok Build CLI, you will also see a screen to allow us to retain data to improve the product and model. We will also provide a setting to change your choice.</p><hr/><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="grokcom-build-mode" class="scroll-mt-28 font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary mb-4 mt-12 text-xl leading-snug"><a class="not-prose" href="#grokcom-build-mode">Grok.com Build mode</a></h2></span><p>If you are using the Build mode in grok.com or via the mobile apps, chats and build sessions are retained for product functionality in order to allow developing and publishing apps across multiple sessions. Unlike for regular chat, Private Chats on grok.com and mobile are not available for Build mode currently to ensure publishing and building apps across multiple sessions is possible.</p><p>If the &quot;improve the model&quot; toggle is enabled from grok.com or mobile data controls settings, these chats via Build mode and build sessions, including data from created apps, may be used for product and model improvements.</p><hr/><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="is-the-xai-api-hipaa-compliant" class="scroll-mt-28 font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary mb-4 mt-12 text-xl leading-snug"><a class="not-prose" href="#is-the-xai-api-hipaa-compliant">Is the xAI API HIPAA compliant?</a></h2></span><p>To inquire about a Business Associate Agreement (BAA), please complete our <a href="https://x.ai/legal/baa" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">BAA Questionnaire</a>. A member of our team will review your responses and reach out with next steps.</p><hr/><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="is-xai-gdpr-and-soc-ii-compliant" class="scroll-mt-28 font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary mb-4 mt-12 text-xl leading-snug"><a class="not-prose" href="#is-xai-gdpr-and-soc-ii-compliant">Is xAI GDPR and SOC II compliant?</a></h2></span><p>We are SOC 2 Type 2 compliant. Customers with a signed NDA can refer to our <a href="https://trust.x.ai/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Trust Center</a> for up-to-date information on our certifications and data governance.</p><hr/><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="do-you-have-audit-logs" class="scroll-mt-28 font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary mb-4 mt-12 text-xl leading-snug"><a class="not-prose" href="#do-you-have-audit-logs">Do you have Audit Logs?</a></h2></span><p>Team admins are able to view an audit log of user interactions. This lists all of the user interactions with our API server. You can view it at <a href="https://console.x.ai/team/default/audit?utm_source=docs&amp;utm_medium=referral&amp;utm_campaign=developers-faq-security&amp;utm_content=audit" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">xAI Console -&gt; Audit Log</a>.</p><figure class="flex max-h-[540px] w-full items-center justify-center"><img data-original-src="/assets/docs/resources/faq-console/audit-log.png" data-original-width="1255" data-original-height="532" alt="Audit log example" loading="lazy" width="1273" height="540" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="border object-contain object-center rounded-md w-full" style="color:transparent;background-size:cover;background-position:50% 50%;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-image:url(&quot;data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg xmlns=&#x27;http://www.w3.org/2000/svg&#x27; Do not share keys between teammates to avoid unauthorized access. Store keys securely using environment variables or secret management tools. Avoid committing keys to public repositories or source code.</p><p>Rotate keys regularly for added security. If you suspect a compromise, log into the xAI console first. Ensure you are viewing the correct team, as API keys are tied to specific teams. Navigate to the &quot;API Keys&quot; section via the sidebar. In the API Keys table, click the vertical ellipsis (three dots) next to the key. Select &quot;Disable key&quot; to deactivate it temporarily or &quot;Delete key&quot; to remove it permanently. Then, click the &quot;Create API Key&quot; button to generate a new one and update your applications.</p><p>xAI partners with GitHub&#x27;s Secret Scanning program to detect leaked keys. If a leak is found, we disable the key and notify you via email. Monitor your account for unusual activity to stay protected.</p></div><div class="mx-auto w-full max-w-2xl group-has-[[data-openapi-section]]/prose:max-w-7xl
